name: agentcontext
description: Fivetran's Agent Context MCP provides AI agents with business context through the Model Context Protocol.

interface.longDescription:
Fivetran's Agent Context MCP provides AI agents the full breadth of business context needed to answer questions and take action, reliably. Built on Fivetran's open context layer, it infers and curates context from every enterprise system — including data sources, schemas, concepts, knowledge bases, and analytical metadata — and exposes it through the Model Context Protocol.

Agent Context MCP powers natural-language search, data-aware assistants, coding workflows, and custom AI applications. Its standard MCP interface makes it easy to bring rich, trusted, and comprehensive business context into the AI tools teams are already using, including Claude, ChatGPT, coding agents, and custom applications.
